question: Do fresh-seed Trust Governor and Power Broker champions improve strategic diversity and reduce the apparent Capability Rusher advantage without creating a new faction, strategy, backend, or matchup exploit?

selectionRule.profilePromotion: A champion may replace its authored source only if it improves fresh-seed competitiveness without introducing credible dominance or materially increasing forced no-ops.
selectionRule.rulesBoundary: This test may improve the evidence policy ecology but cannot select a physical rule change.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: Human counterplay, negotiation quality, teachability, fairness, duration, and fun remain outside the simulation.
